title: Engagement Ring & Heart Embroidery
author: Embroidery Designs
description:
Celebrate your big news with this sparkling Engagement Ring & Heart machine embroidery design. Featuring a beautiful diamond-style ring nestled inside a charming pink heart pocket, this motif is the ultimate way to announce a “Yes!” and add a touch of romance to your bridal projects.
The design utilizes soft, tonal pinks and crisp white with high-quality textured fills to create a professional and elegant look. It’s an ideal choice for personalizing bachelorette party favors, bridal shower gift bags, custom “Bride-to-be” apparel, or even decorative accents for a rehearsal dinner. Whether you’re stitching on denim, satin, or cotton, this romantic design ensures a clean and sophisticated finish.
This machine embroidery design comes with multiple embroidery file formats and can be used with multiple embroidery machines.
